title: Day trip in Houston Texas with Lunch
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
I have boosters for ages 4 until 9 years old
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Welcome to Htown! Houston is the best city in Texas in my opinion and there's no place like it! The city is filled with diversity, southern hospitality, good times, love and hope. There's always something to do and good food to eat. I fall in love with this city everyday. It's such a hidden gem and I would love to show you around! I look forward to spending the day with you and you exploring Houston like a local or a tourist! I still feel like a tourist and I've been here for a long time. I will try to squeeze this big city in, in one day. I can't wait to show you around!
